steps.title: Open isolated command session
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.

Valid sequential JSON requests only. No malformed JSON, missing command, oversized line, absent setup, repeated start, overlapping async request or native-accessibility route is claimed. Only the explicitly asserted capability fields are associated.
actions: launch matching automation app --scriv-cli with the FILM-J01 persistent isolated run
capabilities

expectations.description: Launch succeeds and capabilities advertise the isolated persistent workspace, disabled cloud network and required command/menu/delegate surfaces.

mappings.why: The valid automation launch accepts the CLI argument and prepared isolated capability.
The initialized workspace accepts a bounded valid stdin request and delivers it on the main queue; oversize rejection is unclaimed.
A valid sequential request is decoded with its response ID and accepted prepared-run/busy guards. Error and busy outcomes are unclaimed.
The synchronous capabilities result reaches the successful response envelope.
The public response is serialized and emitted through the stdio protocol consumed by the journey.
The capabilities command runs with the initialized window and prepared isolated capability.
Layout and capabilities dispatch produce the observed isolation and semantic-command declaration; colocated protocol/schema fields are not all separately asserted.
Layout and capabilities dispatch produce the observed isolation and semantic-command declaration; colocated protocol/schema fields are not all separately asserted.
The returned delegate-command list contains script-insert as asserted.
The menu scopes and run identity are returned; selected scopes are asserted here and the run ID is retained for later checkpoints.
The initial persistent/non-resumed workspace flags equal the expected object.
The returned command list contains every required film command. This does not prove all advertised commands.
The constructed capability response is returned to the real session.

steps.title: Locate and activate owned swatch
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.

The existing character editor is open. Associations cover the ordinary owned-window/view traversal and accepted control target only; settings-scene ownership, hidden/covered refusal and native accessibility remain gaps.
actions: snapshot
snapshot after locating the exact standard swatch path and label
activate target=the same standard swatch path

expectations.description: Assert the complete ordered standard palette, stable unique sibling paths, enabled/hittable selected swatch and a dispatched activation.

mappings.why: Owned windows and presented-controller windows provide the palette traversal. This does not claim a particular separate-window branch or settings-scene discovery.
Visible view traversal produces the ordered path/label palette whose membership and path stability are asserted.
The selected visible control is reported hittable through the owned-window, presentation, clipping and hit-test acceptance path. Rejection variants are unclaimed.
The exact selected control passes interaction, enabled and hit-test gates before dispatch.
The standard colour swatch is a UIControl registered for touchUpInside; the accepted control path sends that event and the witness requires dispatch. The primaryActionTriggered branch is unclaimed.
The standard colour swatch is a UIControl registered for touchUpInside; the accepted control path sends that event and the witness requires dispatch. The primaryActionTriggered branch is unclaimed.

The standard palette witness independently checks exact labels, and repeated snapshots preserve the same path/label pairs. This covers ordinary labels only; sensitive aggregation redaction is not claimed.

steps.title: Observe and select workspace tab
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.

A normal nonsensitive workspace tab control is mounted; the helper is used throughout FILM-J01. Mappings cover the asserted path/identifier/label/readiness/tab fields, not every field sharing a dictionary line or sensitive redaction.
actions: snapshot
select target=workspace-tabs index=the observed Script tab index when needed
snapshot until workspace-tabs reports the selected index

expectations.description: The actual workspace contains the requested tab and the enabled, hittable control reports the requested selection.

mappings.why: Snapshot builds ordinary nonsensitive records; identifier and hittable state are consumed by readyTabs. Sensitive and aggregate-redaction true branches are unclaimed.
Snapshot builds ordinary nonsensitive records; identifier and hittable state are consumed by readyTabs. Sensitive and aggregate-redaction true branches are unclaimed.
Ordinary controls publish enabled state after presentation/ancestor checks. The selected tab readiness is asserted; disabled/covered rejection variants are unclaimed.
The actual segment titles and selected index are returned and compared after selection.

steps.title: Discover and dispatch workspace Save
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.
The real workspace responder chain is active. This associates enabled Save discovery and successful dispatch, not every responder subclass, modifier, focus fallback or key-rejection outcome.
actions: keys
key input=s modifiers=[command]

expectations.description: Assert that the actual workspace exposes its enabled Command-S action, then require exactly the successful dispatch response.

mappings.why: Enabled commands are collected from the current responder chain and the witness locates the workspace Save action.
Modifier names preserve the requested Command modifier used by the exact key comparison.
keys exposes the command and key resolves and dispatches the matching action. The accepted path does not establish every inline guard failure.

steps.title: Read exact saved synthetic packages
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.

The sentinel and authored project have already been saved. Only valid owned regular packages below the limits are associated; unsafe roots, symlinks, oversized content, missing publication, descriptor errors and malformed JSON are unclaimed.
actions: persisted-projects

expectations.description: Compare the entire saved sentinel and authored project to the expected models, and compare loaded state at the chapter checkpoint.

mappings.why: Read the configured synthetic root and eligible .scriv packages using the accepted directory/package/open path. The full exported models are compared; rejection sides are unclaimed.
Read and decode bounded regular project.json bytes and return the saved objects; the complete package model comparison witnesses the valid-file path.

steps.title: Replace character field text
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.
FILM-J01 creates cast profiles using ordinary Name, Biography and Appearance inputs. The helper observes exact text; composition, secure inputs, invalid target and editing refusal are unclaimed.
actions: snapshot to locate the one requested character input
text target=the located Name, Biography or Appearance input text=the current film.cast field
snapshot until that input retains the exact text

expectations.description: The located native character input retains the exact supplied UTF-16 text.

mappings.why: Snapshot reports the ordinary text field/text view content inspected by the helper. Selection/editability/style metadata is not associated here.
text accepts ordinary nonsensitive field/view input, selects existing content and inserts the replacement. Both field and view forms are used by FILM-J01 cast creation.

steps.title: Replace exact UTF-16 selection
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.
The new dialogue editor is focused and contains film.draftLine; the complete preceding add-dialogue workflow is required. Only the valid nonsensitive UITextView selection/type path is associated.
actions: text target=current script editor text=film.draftLine
snapshot until exact draft and caret
selection target=current script editor start=the cafe-combining-accent start end=that UTF-16 span end
snapshot until exact draft and selected span
type target=current script editor text=café
snapshot until exact revised text and collapsed caret

expectations.description: Observe the exact decomposed-text selection, then the composed café replacement and caret, before finishing and observing saved revised text.

mappings.why: selection builds and installs the valid exact UTF-16 text range used by the composed-text replacement. Invalid and secure selection branches are unclaimed.
type accepts the supplied ordinary nonsensitive text.
The focused editable UITextView inserts the replacement into the selected range and the subsequent snapshot verifies text/caret.

steps.title: Import two synthetic image versions
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.
The selected existing cue is active. Imports are awaited serially for coral then blue; unsupported fixtures, async overlap, errors and cancellation are unclaimed.
actions: import-local-image fixture=coral
persisted-projects until exact first image asset and cue binding
import-local-image fixture=blue
persisted-projects until exact second image asset, previousVersionId and cue binding

expectations.description: Each import reports dispatched/imported/cleanupVerified and produces exactly the expected image metadata, version chain and cue binding.

mappings.why: The accepted synthetic image request enters the async command, awaits the import and returns its successful result with the saved response ID.
The async image branch exits after scheduling its owned task; sequential subsequent commands complete after the defer clears the in-progress state.

steps.title: Activate historical image cell
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.
The real image picker is open with two imported versions. Only selection of the one visible historical UICollectionViewCell is associated.
actions: activate target=preview-version
snapshot until image picker is present
activate target=the unique hittable Version 1 cell path
activate target=image-picker-use-selection
persisted-projects until the original cue refers to firstImageID
snapshot until the picker is dismissed

expectations.description: Select the unique historical Version 1 cell and assert the exact persisted cue image binding and picker dismissal.

mappings.why: A real collection cell resolves to its owning collection/index and is selected through the public delegate contract. Refused/invalid collection selection is unclaimed.

steps.title: Describe nested portrait menu
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.

The matching character is selected and its portrait menu control is visible. Only concrete menus/actions and the asserted title, attributes and on/off state are associated; bounds failures, deferred elements and mixed state are unclaimed.
actions: menu target=character-portrait-options
menu-action target=character-portrait-options scope=character-portrait-options action=the requested portrait title characterID=current character imageID=chosen imported image

expectations.description: The menu has one primary tree, the expected section count and one enabled visible action with the expected on/off state; dispatch reports the semantic menu route.

mappings.why: The bounded menu walker describes actual nested UIMenu/UIAction titles, children, attributes and selected state compared by the witness.
Primary and absent secondary menu trees are serialized for the observed portrait control.
The absent context tree and concrete primary/secondary trees are returned and compared.

steps.title: Import selected-dialogue audio
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.

The selected dialogue has been established by opening/finishing its real editor. The tested request imports synthetic tone into selected-dialogue and is awaited serially. Invalid data, unsafe fixtures, async overlap and error responses are unclaimed.
actions: import-audio attachment=selected-dialogue base64=syntheticPCM({silence:false})
persisted-projects until exact asset and dialogue-linked clip

expectations.description: The awaited import returns dispatched/imported/cleanupVerified; exact asset bytes/metadata and complete selected-dialogue clip placement/attachment fields are checked.

mappings.why: The valid audio request shape, payload and selected workspace enter the supported async route.
The command records in-progress state, retains the reply ID, awaits importWAV and returns its successful result; defer restores availability.
The asynchronous audio branch returns without falling through into synchronous command dispatch.

steps.title: Set audio clip volume
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.
The real local-audio sheet and its imported clip are open. Only finite in-range slider updates are associated; out-of-range/NaN/wrong-target rejection is unclaimed.
actions: snapshot to reveal the clip-volume slider
slider target=the clip volume control path value=0.375
snapshot until the slider reports 0.375
persisted-projects until the clip volume is exactly 0.375

expectations.description: The completed trim is saved; setting clip volume to 0.375 produces exactly that model value, using the slider helper that also polls its native value.

mappings.why: The control snapshot publishes actual slider value and bounds consumed by the volume helper.
The accepted in-range numeric value is applied to UISlider and dispatched through valueChanged.

steps.title: Insert through mounted script delegate
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.

The film dialogue editor is the exact mounted isolated editing session, with a collapsed valid end selection and existing confirmed identity/audio. Only the accepted single-line insertion is associated; guard failures, owner-search exhaustion and refused delegate insertion are unclaimed.
actions: selection target=current dialogue editor start=film.revisedLine.length end=film.revisedLine.length
snapshot until exact caret
script-interaction-counts
script-insert target=current dialogue editor text= Ready.
script-interaction-counts
snapshot until appended text and exact caret
keys
key input=Escape modifiers=[]
persisted-projects until the exact revised dialogue

expectations.description: Insertion reports delegate acceptance, increments onTextEdit once without a merge callback, displays the exact appended text/caret, and preserves confirmed identity, existing word IDs and unrelated model state.

mappings.why: The accepted script insertion is tied to its real delegate row, active isolated workspace and mounted window; rejection branches on these conditions are unclaimed.
The owning ScriptScreenController and ready current editing session are resolved before insertion. Exhaustion/stale-session variants are unclaimed.
The valid selected UTF-16 range is checked against both source text and UITextInput offsets before the delegate call.

steps.title: Dispatch owned duration menu action
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.
The second-scene direction exists and Layers is expanded. This witnesses the concrete secondary menu and the positive Owned duration route, not arbitrary action dispatch or error branches.
actions: menu target=the exact direction control path
menu-action target=that direction path action=Owned duration…
snapshot until the owned duration editor shows 0.000
presented-alerts
loaded-project

expectations.description: The secondary menu exactly contains the enabled visible Owned duration action, dispatch succeeds, the editor opens with exact original duration and the complete project remains unchanged.

mappings.why: The Owned duration menu-action branch routes the real owning control into the supported semantic dispatcher.

steps.title: Reveal character input by native scrolling
preconditions: Existing FILM-J01 (tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/short-film), with its preceding chapters, isolated persistent workspace and matching automation build. These are source-to-assertion associations, not a new run or measured line/branch coverage.

FILM-J01 uses this helper for character fields/swatches. The scroll action is conditional on the requested view being offscreen; this association does not claim the branch ran on every window size or that clipping/covered cases pass.
actions: snapshot to locate one requested character input
scroll target=its reachable native scroll ancestor y=ancestor offset plus target frame offset minus 20 when offscreen
snapshot until the same unique input is hittable

expectations.description: The helper requires one exact target and, when scrolling is needed, a reachable ancestor and a subsequent hittable target.

mappings.why: The ordinary window-relative frame locates the native scroll ancestor and target offset.
The ordinary window-relative frame locates the native scroll ancestor and target offset.
The scroll offset supplied by snapshot is used to compute the requested native scroll position.
The finite scroll request clamps to the native content range and changes its vertical offset; the same target is subsequently required hittable.
